description: Active specification source inventory. Validation results are recorded separately and bind source hashes.

specs.title: Participation restrictions and retained rights
rules: An account restriction records its human decision independently of project state
A ban blocks new credit and commitments while existing funded rights remain
stories: Story: Restrict new participation while preserving funded awards and appeals

specs.title: App
rules: A greeter holds the last name it greeted and how many greetings it gave
Only a name that is not empty can be greeted
Once someone has been greeted, the greeter holds a name
The number of greetings is never negative
Every step adds exactly one greeting
A greeting is for the name it was given
The greeter can give a second greeting
stories: Story: Say hello

specs.title: Account identity and session lifetime
rules: The actor identity remains stable through account changes
A verified GitHub sign-in requires the same actor and visibility disclosure
Closure invalidates sessions and public membership until explicit reopening
An optional X identity stays reserved after disconnect

specs.title: Account-bound email enrollment
rules: Enrollment keeps pending and verified addresses separate
